'''Shane Seeker''' (Japanese: '''カラバリ''' ''Karabari'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|JN}} episode ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]''. He is a {{tc|collector}} of [[Shiny Pokémon]].

==History==
After obtaining a Shiny {{p|Psyduck}} as his first Pokémon, Shane Seeker decided to complete his [[Pokédex]] with nothing but Shiny Pokémon, no matter how long it would take. In the {{aniseries|JN}} episode ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]'', he was exploring the [[Colossus Ruins]] in the [[Desert Resort]], where he and his Psyduck were saved by {{Ash}} and {{AP|Pikachu}} after they attacked the two {{p|Cofagrigus}} that had trapped them inside.

Shane Seeker explained his profession and later joined Ash, [[Goh]], {{OBP|Kira|JN014}}, and the excavation {{OBP|leader|JN014}} in their exploration of the ruins. He also reluctantly participated in a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] against a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{TP|Goh|Golurk}}, which the group defeated and Goh caught.

He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!]]''.

==Trivia==
* Shane Seeker is the first {{pkmn|Trainer}} in the {{pkmn|animated series}} who is known to own more than one [[Shiny Pokémon]].
* [[Netflix]] closed captions incorrectly refer to Shane Seeker as '''Shame Seeker'''.
* His name is a play on the fan term "Shiny seeker".
